title.zh: Revolut tricked into handing hackers the passports and Bitcoin histories of wealthy customers
title.en: Revolut tricked into handing hackers the passports and Bitcoin histories of wealthy customers

current_state.zh: 意大利当局正在调查一起与Revolut数据泄露相关的政府电子邮件泄露事件，黑客涉嫌利用被入侵的认证电子邮件账户获取Revolut客户数据。
current_state.en: Italian authorities are investigating a government email breach linked to the Revolut data leak, in which hackers allegedly used a compromised certified email account to obtain Revolut customer data.

updates.title_en: Revolut tricked into handing hackers the passports and Bitcoin histories of wealthy customers
updates.what_changed_zh: Revolut disclosed wealthy customers' passports, verification selfies, addresses, and Bitcoin transaction histories after being tricked by a fraudulent government data request.

updates.title_zh: Italy investigates government email breach linked to Revolut data leak
updates.title_en: Italy investigates government email breach linked to Revolut data leak
updates.what_changed_zh: 意大利邮政警察正在调查一起政府电子邮件泄露事件，黑客涉嫌利用该泄露获取Revolut客户数据；意大利CERT-AGID报告自2026年初以来已处理超过650起涉及滥用或非法PEC账户的案件。
updates.what_changed_en: Italian cybercrime police are investigating a government email breach that hackers allegedly used to obtain Revolut customer data; Italy’s CERT-AGID reported over 650 cases of abused or illicit PEC accounts since the start of 2026.
updates.current_state_zh: 意大利当局正在调查一起与Revolut数据泄露相关的政府电子邮件泄露事件，黑客涉嫌利用被入侵的认证电子邮件账户获取Revolut客户数据。
updates.current_state_en: Italian authorities are investigating a government email breach linked to the Revolut data leak, in which hackers allegedly used a compromised certified email account to obtain Revolut customer data.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Italian cybercrime police are investigating a government email breach that hackers allegedly used to obtain Revolut customer data, with over 650 cases of abused certified email accounts reported.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Italian cybercrime police are investigating a government email breach that hackers allegedly used to obtain Revolut customer data, with over 650 cases of abused certified email accounts reported.
